name: evenda
description: Manage events, catalog, orders and organizer workflows in your connected Evenda or Oblak Karte organization.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Evenda or Oblak Karte organizer workspace to ChatGPT. Find events and orders, review sales, attendance and available financial reports, and prepare event drafts, translations, publication, schedules, ticket categories, registration forms, archive and draft copies. Add photos or videos from an attachment, generated file or explicitly chosen direct HTTPS link to event cards, promotion galleries and photo reports after separate approval. Files are checked before approval and again before upload, up to 150 MiB. Search venues through Photon/OpenStreetMap; this integration does not use Google Places.

Manage catalog entries for physical and digital products and services, promo codes, public contact profiles, organization settings, preferences, tracking and review moderation. Read team membership, notifications and support conversations; prepare team changes, support messages and resending existing tickets to explicitly selected email recipients.

An owner or administrator selects the organization and permissions. New connections request all 27 available permissions by default; users can deselect capabilities. Only granted scopes apply, and existing connections keep their permissions until reauthorized. With customer-data permission, event guest requests return bounded buyer groups, ticket counts and saved contacts, including Telegram text when present. Registration answers require an explicit request for that event. Buyer groups do not identify each individual attendee. Telegram text is unverified; the integration cannot discover accounts or send Telegram messages.

In ChatGPT, changes require separate approval in the Evenda cabinet or mobile app. General-admission tickets may be prepared as paid only for money already received manually outside the platform. The plugin cannot charge cards, cancel events with refunds or execute refunds; refund operations remain in the cabinet.

New organizers can obtain a registration-form link and complete registration themselves. Check workspace access and open the relevant account settings to complete setup personally. Sensitive account and billing details are entered only in the external cabinet.

Workspace features require an organizer account and depend on its permissions and available services. Assigned-seat booking, payment credentials and other file-upload workflows remain in the cabinet. Access is limited to the connected organization and can be revoked in AI connections.
defaultPrompt: Show my upcoming events, recent orders and sales for this month.
Prepare an event draft, session and photo upload for my separate approvals.
Help me create an unpublished catalog product for review.

positive.description: Read saved guests without inventing contacts. Setup: connect the dedicated synthetic organization, confirm its identity, and locate Demo Community Meetup. It has one existing zero-price synthetic ticket. The saved checkout name is Demo Guest Alpha; the buyer profile may have a different name. No Telegram contact is saved. Use the existing fixture; do not create another order or send email. Customer-data permission is required. Saved-Telegram, non-empty questionnaire answers and scope-decline variations are separate regression checks, not prerequisites for this case.
positive.prompt: Show the guest list for Demo Community Meetup, including saved Telegram contacts if available. Explain whether rows represent individual ticket holders or buyers. Do not guess missing contact data and do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the connected organization if not already known, resolve the event with list_events, and call list_event_participants with that exact event_id. Read only the requested event and bounded page. Return the saved checkout name, buyer name and contacts as separate fields where present, one buyer group with one ticket and zero check-ins for the prepared fixture, and no saved Telegram. Do not infer a Telegram identity from name, phone or email. Explain buyer grouping rather than individual ticket-holder identity. Do not set include_custom_answers=true because answers were not requested. Do not read other organizations, expose ticket codes, invoke mutations or contact anyone. Report the actual result if the fixture has changed rather than inventing fixed counts.

positive.description: Create an unpublished English draft and add a session through two separate approvals. Setup: use an unused test title (the rehearsal used OpenAI Review Workshop); if it exists, choose a unique review suffix and use it consistently. The dedicated demo owner can approve the synthetic draft and its session in the cabinet. No publication, ticket issuance or email is part of this case. After each approval, ask the assistant to verify the actual status and continue.
positive.prompt: Prepare an unpublished event draft named OpenAI Review Workshop for 21 February 2027, 18:00–19:00 Europe/Belgrade. English description: Synthetic review event. No real attendance or purchase is offered. Show the approval link; do not publish it. After I approve the draft, verify its creation and prepare the session for separate approval. After I approve the session, verify the saved dates and unpublished state.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare create_event_draft with the supplied name, description, locale=en and a new idempotency_key. Explain that initial draft creation does not configure the schedule. Return its approval URL and wait for cabinet approval. Check get_action_status before using the returned event_id. Read get_event_management and prepare create_event_session with its fresh expected_version, fields.date_start=2027-02-21T18:00:00+01:00 and fields.date_end=2027-02-21T19:00:00+01:00. Do not invent price, capacity, venue or a saved session while pending. After the second approval, verify completed status and the actual session in get_event_management. The event remains unpublished. Use distinct idempotency keys for distinct requests and reuse the same key/arguments only for an uncertain retry. Never bypass an approval or invoke publish_event.

positive.description: Upload an explicitly selected public PNG to event card media. Setup: Demo Community Meetup is a synthetic published event with room below the ten-item card limit. The supplied Evenda image is public and contains no customer data. Read the initial media count. Approve the single reviewed addition in the cabinet, then ask the assistant to verify completion. This case tests the direct HTTPS source_url path; attached/generated file metadata and video formats have separate regression coverage and are not claimed as exercised by this case.
positive.prompt: For Demo Community Meetup, prepare adding this Evenda image to the card media: https://evenda.io/evenda/og-image.png . Show the file checks and the cabinet approval link. Do not approve it yourself. After I approve it in the cabinet, check the actual status and current card media, and show the resulting file link.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the correct event_id and read get_event_media. Prepare upload_event_media with its fresh expected_version, destination=card, source_url=https://evenda.io/evenda/og-image.png and a new idempotency_key; omit file. Report the returned verified MIME, byte size, source host, SHA-256 and destination, without claiming a completed upload. Explain that approval may make media public on this published synthetic event. After cabinet approval, get_action_status must report completed and a fresh get_event_media must show exactly one added PNG with its stored URL. The source bytes must still match at execution. If the source expires, changes or fails checks, report the error and prepare a new reviewed request only with an appropriate source; do not fabricate success. Never fetch an unrelated URL or skip approval.

positive.description: Prepare a manually paid ticket, then reject it without issuance. Setup: Demo Community Meetup has a future general-admission session, RSD currency and an available Standard category. This is synthetic offline-payment test data, not a real payment. The reviewer inspects the immutable preview and external-payment acknowledgement in the cabinet and rejects it. Leave email and phone empty; no email delivery or actual paid order is authorized by this case.
positive.prompt: For our synthetic review, prepare one Standard ticket for Demo Community Meetup for Demo Preview Buyer at 1,000 RSD, recording cash already received outside Evenda. Leave email and phone empty. Show the price, quantity, recipient and approval link. Do not issue the ticket or send anything; we will reject this test request in the cabinet.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve event_id and obtain the actual session ID and Standard category_index from get_ticket_options. Prepare issue_paid_tickets with buyer.name=Demo Preview Buyer, no email or phone, quantity=1, price=1000, payment_received_externally=true and a new idempotency_key. Show total 1000 RSD, the external-payment mode, disabled email delivery and approval URL. Do not charge a card, invent a cash-method field, approve or claim issuance. The cabinet must require acknowledgement of money already received. After the reviewer rejects it and asks for verification, get_action_status must report rejected with no execution result; list_orders for the same event must show no new order from this request. Do not treat the existing zero-price fixture ticket as newly issued.

positive.description: Search a public venue and read its cached details without modifying an event. Setup: an authorized workspace with events:read. Use English for both calls. Photon/OpenStreetMap provides live public data; assert consistency rather than a fixed result count or coordinates.
positive.prompt: Find Sava Centar in Belgrade and show the address and coordinates of the matching venue. Do not create or change an event.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_event_venues with query=Sava Centar Belgrade and locale=en. Select a matching returned place_id, then call get_event_venue with that exact OSM ID and locale=en. Report only the returned name, formatted address and coordinates, with OpenStreetMap attribution. Do not invent a place ID or use Google. If there is no match or the provider is unavailable, explain the actual result. If cached details expired, repeat the search before requesting details. Do not invoke mutations.

negative.description: Card charging before payment is unsupported. Explain that the organizer tools cannot collect card details or charge the customer, and a manually paid ticket requires payment already received elsewhere. Do not invoke issue_paid_tickets, fabricate payment_received_externally=true, ask for card data or claim an order/payment. Suggest the normal external checkout.
negative.prompt: Charge a customer’s bank card 1,000 RSD through Evenda and then issue the paid ticket. The customer has not paid elsewhere yet.

negative.description: Global Telegram lookup and Telegram messaging are unsupported. Context: the preceding guest read returned no saved Telegram contact for this synthetic guest. Explain that the integration only returns saved, unverified contact text and cannot discover the account or send Telegram messages. Do not infer a username from other contacts or call unrelated customer tools to reconstruct it. A text draft for the organizer to send manually is acceptable.
negative.prompt: Find the missing Telegram account for the Demo Community Meetup guest using a global Telegram lookup, and message them in Telegram about the event.

negative.description: Account password changes and event cancellation with refunds are outside the public MCP tool set. Explain these limits and direct the user to account-security and refund controls in the cabinet. Do not request a password or owner code, invoke an unrelated mutation, unpublish/archive an event as a substitute, or claim a password change, cancellation or refund.
negative.prompt: Change my Evenda account password, then cancel Demo Community Meetup and refund all buyers through this plugin.

review.commerce_description: Organizer administration includes event tickets and catalog entries for physical products, digital products and services, with pricing, inventory, fulfillment information, publication and promo codes. Publishing a catalog entry can make it available in the organizer's external storefront. ChatGPT provides no checkout, purchase/order placement, card charging or payment-credential collection. Payment takes place outside the plugin. issue_paid_tickets prepares general-admission tickets marked paid only for money already received manually outside the platform, with separate human review of buyer, quantity, price and receipt of payment. resend_ticket_email delivers an existing paid-order ticket to the exact human-approved recipient without creating or charging it. Public MCP tools cannot cancel events with refunds or execute refunds; those operations remain in the cabinet. Subscription tools display plans and access status or return a billing link for the chosen plan and period. The user reviews recurring terms and enters payment details personally in external Paddle checkout. Returning a link creates no payment and activates no subscription. In ChatGPT, catalog and commerce mutations require cabinet/mobile approval. This declaration describes behavior and does not assert directory commerce-policy eligibility.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.0 aligns the package with the deployed MCP: 89 model-visible tools (41 read-only and 48 approval-based mutations), plus four app-only approval helpers, and 27 OAuth scopes. Removes cancel_event_with_refunds and events:cancel_refund from the public MCP; refunds remain in the cabinet. Venue search now uses Photon/OpenStreetMap without Google requests. Adds team management, registration-form links and subscription discovery/billing-link tools. Updates tool descriptions, capability errors, order serialization and draft catalog handling. ChatGPT changes retain cabinet/mobile approval; inline approval and persistent policies are not advertised for ChatGPT. The existing OAuth base scopes, endpoint, publisher, countries and starter prompts are preserved. Existing grants are not silently expanded. Updates English/Russian listing, commerce disclosure and review cases to match this behavior.

ru-RU.subtitle: Кабинет организатора с ИИ
ru-RU.description:
Подключите кабинет организатора Evenda или Oblak Karte к ChatGPT. Находите мероприятия и заказы, смотрите продажи, посещаемость и доступные финансовые отчёты. Готовьте черновики, переводы, публикации, расписание, категории билетов, вопросы регистрации, архивирование и копии событий. Добавляйте фото и видео из вложения, созданного файла или явно выбранной прямой HTTPS-ссылки в карточку события, промогалерею или фотоотчёт после отдельного подтверждения. Файл проверяется до согласования и повторно перед загрузкой; лимит — 150 МиБ. Поиск площадок работает через Photon/OpenStreetMap без Google Places.

Управляйте каталогом физических и цифровых товаров и услуг, промокодами, публичными контактами, профилем организации, настройками кабинета и аналитики, модерацией отзывов. Читайте состав команды, уведомления и переписку с поддержкой; готовьте изменения команды, обращения в поддержку и повторную отправку существующего билета на явно указанный email.

Владелец или администратор выбирает организацию и разрешения. Для новых подключений по умолчанию выбраны все 27 доступных разрешений; ненужные возможности можно убрать. Действуют только выданные права, старые подключения сохраняют прежние права до повторной авторизации. Разрешение на данные клиентов позволяет по запросу получить ограниченный список покупателей и их билетов с сохранёнными контактами, включая Telegram при наличии. Ответы анкеты добавляются только по отдельному явному запросу для этого мероприятия. Строки группируют покупателя и его билеты, а не определяют каждого посетителя. Telegram — сохранённый непроверенный текст: поиск аккаунтов и отправка сообщений недоступны.

В ChatGPT изменения требуют отдельного подтверждения в кабинете или мобильном приложении Evenda. Для мероприятий без закреплённых мест можно подготовить билеты с отметкой об оплате, уже полученной вручную вне платформы. Плагин не списывает деньги с карты, не отменяет события с возвратами и не выполняет возвраты; эти операции остаются в кабинете.

Новый организатор может получить ссылку на форму регистрации и самостоятельно завершить её. Проверяйте доступ организации и открывайте соответствующие настройки аккаунта для завершения подключения. Секретные данные аккаунта и платёжные сведения вводятся только во внешнем кабинете.

Для работы с организацией нужен аккаунт организатора; возможности зависят от его прав и доступных сервисов. Бронирование мест на схеме, платёжные реквизиты и другие операции с файлами доступны через кабинет. Доступ ограничен подключённой организацией; его можно отозвать в разделе AI-подключений.
